buildCommand: if [ ! -d flutter ]; then git clone https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git -b stable --depth 1; fi && if [ ! -f lib/secrets.dart ]; then echo "class Secrets { static const String geminiApiKey = '${GEMINI_API_KEY}'; }" > lib/secrets.dart; fi && if [ ! -f .env ]; then echo "API_KEY=${GEMINI_API_KEY}" > .env; fi && ./flutter/bin/flutter build web --release
